## Checklist

- [ ] CI passes (`cargo test --workspace` + `pnpm vitest` green locally)
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests covering it
- [ ] User-visible changes are documented (wiki, README, or inline help updated)
- [ ] No `TODO`/`FIXME` left in changed files (or each one has a tracking issue)
- [ ] No AI co-author tags (`Co-Authored-By: ...`) in any commit message
- [ ] Commit messages follow conventional commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`, etc.)
- [ ] Branch targets `main` (not a release branch unless this is a hotfix)
